name: Shipping Route
blurb: Dark-mode tracking map: a dotted route arcs across the ocean from the warehouse to your door while a parcel icon flies it; each line is a tracking-status pin (ORDER PLACED, SHIPPED, IN CUSTOMS...) with the key word; a big B-roll window docks to the side; on the turn the box lands, flaps open and the reveal plays out of it; title on the shipping label.
